title: Playground Safety Risk Assessment
description: Free Playground Safety Risk Assessment template for education you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers playground information, playground hazard identification and risk assessment, playground inspection checklist.

Playground Inspection Checklist

SURFACING & FALL ZONES:

☐ Loose fill surface depth at least 6-12 inches (depending on height)

☐ No compacted areas under and around equipment

☐ Fall zones extend minimum 6 feet from equipment

☐ No hard surfaces (concrete, asphalt) in fall zones

☐ Surface material evenly distributed

☐ Impact attenuating surface tested (if unitary)

☐ Drainage adequate (no standing water)

EQUIPMENT STRUCTURE:

☐ All equipment securely anchored to ground

☐ No rust, corrosion, or deterioration

☐ All bolts and connections tight

☐ No missing or broken parts

☐ Wood components not splintered or cracked

☐ Plastic components not cracked or faded

☐ Moving parts operate smoothly

☐ Swing seats lightweight and in good condition

☐ Swing hangers and connections secure

ENTRAPMENT & PROTRUSION CHECK:

☐ All openings between 3.5-9 inches checked with gauge (should not admit gauge)

☐ No V-shaped openings that could entrap head

☐ No protruding bolts (bolt ends covered or cut flush)

☐ No S-hooks open (crimped closed)

☐ No ropes or cords that could form a loop

☐ Guardrails on platforms >30 inches high

☐ Guardrail openings less than 3.5 inches or greater than 9 inches (no entrapment)

☐ No sharp edges or points

FENCING & PERIMETER:

☐ Playground properly fenced/secured from roads/parking

☐ Gates self-closing and self-latching

☐ Fence in good repair (no holes, sharp points)

☐ No access to hazardous areas nearby

☐ Perimeter clear of hazards (rocks, trees, etc.)

☐ Signage posted with rules and age-appropriateness

MAINTENANCE & HOUSEKEEPING:

☐ No litter, glass, or debris

☐ No animal waste or pests

☐ No poisonous plants (poison ivy, etc.) in/around playground

☐ No tripping hazards (exposed footings, roots, etc.)

☐ Edging secure and not creating trip hazard

☐ Drainage adequate (no standing water)

☐ Mulch/wood chips not contaminated with foreign objects

USE ZONES & SEPARATION:

☐ Equipment grouped by age-appropriateness

☐ Clear separation between active/quiet play areas

☐ Swings located away from other activity

☐ Slide exits clear of traffic patterns

☐ Adequate space between equipment

☐ No cross-traffic through use zones

ACCESSIBILITY:

☐ Accessible route to playground

☐ Transfer stations or accessible equipment available

☐ Surfacing firm/stabile for mobility devices

☐ Ramps with proper slope (≤1:12)

☐ Accessible play components (ground-level or elevated)

☐ Reach ranges appropriate for all users

SUN SAFETY & COMFORT:

☐ Shade structures or trees providing coverage

☐ Water fountain/bottle filler accessible

☐ Seating for supervisors/adults

☐ Sunscreen policy in place

☐ Metal slides facing away from direct sun (or shaded)

☐ Temperature monitoring during hot weather

Annual | Comprehensive safety audit | | |

As Needed | Repairs, surface replenishment | | |

Playground Rules Posting

RECOMMENDED POSTED RULES:

• Adults must supervise children at all times

• Age-appropriate equipment use only (2-5 / 5-12)

• No pushing, shoving, or rough play

• Shoes required

• No ropes, leashes, or items that could cause entanglement

• Slides - go feet first, one at a time

• Swings - sit down, no twisting or jumping

• No climbing on outside of equipment

• No glass containers

• Report injuries and hazards immediately
